characters.name: Sintel
characters.look: a young woman with short red hair, in a grey tank top, a tattoo on her left shoulder; out in the snow, a small lone figure carrying a spear; in the town, in brown clothes
characters.role: a lone traveller searching the mountains for a lost dragon
characters.nameEvidence: Official subtitles (durian.blender.org/wp-content/content/subtitles/sintel_en.srt): "These are dragon lands, Sintel." at film 7:37 = segment 367 s, after this segment ends. The "SINTEL" title card (segment 0 s) names the film, not the figure.

characters.name: Shaman
characters.look: an old man with a grey beard, red face paint and a beaded headband, in heavy red-brown robes, with a carved staff
characters.role: the old man who has taken her into his tent and tends her by the fire
characters.nameEvidence: End credits only ("Shaman"); never said or shown in the film.

characters.name: Scales
characters.look: a small, scaly dragon with a bleeding wing
characters.role: the baby dragon she finds wounded on a rooftop
characters.nameEvidence: Official subtitles (durian.blender.org/wp-content/content/subtitles/sintel_en.srt): "Scales!" at film 3:48 = segment 138 s, after the 120 s segment ends.
